purpose: Describe reproducible encounter-analysis benchmarks without treating a synthetic fixture, deterministic observation or authored recommendation as canonical game content.

field_contract.context_snapshot: Exact Campaign/Scene/Session or synthetic-fixture context plus immutable versions used for analysis.
field_contract.sides: Stable governed references and versions, or explicitly noncanonical synthetic fixture identities; never display-name equivalence.
field_contract.evidence_ledger: Every material input classified as source_truth, inherited_contract, observed_benchmark, authored_methodology or unresolved_gap.
field_contract.factor_review: Subset or full set of P11-F-001..020 with evidence and omissions; absence is explicit.
field_contract.pressure_dimension_review: Independent F012 pressure dimensions; no required composite score.
field_contract.comparison_scope: Why a comparator is valid, which dimensions/factors are comparable and which are not.
field_contract.deterministic_protocol: Mode, seed if applicable, iteration bound, reset rule, versions and checksum inputs.
field_contract.uncertainty: One verified PPIA-11 uncertainty band plus named reasons.
field_contract.expected_findings: Deterministic methodology expectations such as warning, block, pressure focus, reproducibility or recommendation class; not a guaranteed gameplay outcome.
field_contract.calibration_hooks: What later observation would support, weaken or supersede the authored recommendation.

deterministic_protocol_rules: deterministic-script and regression-replay must reproduce the same analysis result for the same immutable inputs.
bounded-seeded-sampling records the seed, bounded sample count and policy version.
sensitivity-sweep changes only named variables and records every delta.
Benchmark execution is nonmutating and may not change source truth or live Session state.
Ambiguous service result uses the owning recovery/idempotency path before retry.
provenance_rules: Synthetic QA fixtures are labeled noncanonical.
Source-grounded benchmark inputs retain exact stable IDs, versions and source coordinates where available.
8D-007 observations remain observed benchmark evidence and its peer bands remain within-domain.
Authored encounter recommendations are never relabeled as recovered source mechanics.
Unresolved gaps remain explicit and may block a responsible recommendation.
privacy_rules: Permission filtering occurs before protected benchmark inputs, counts, derived pressure summaries, warnings, comparisons, exports, diagnostics or AI context.
A Player/observer-safe benchmark projection cannot reveal hidden participants, waves, triggers, objectives, tactics or internal pressure shapes that would disclose them.
Calibration evidence derived from a private Session remains scoped to authorized subjects.
